What we build.

We pick four industries and go deep. Each engagement starts with a 2-week discovery sprint and ends with a production deployment we operate — not a hand-off and a bill.

Practice 01

Oil & Gas Operations

Field ticket reconciliation, lease compliance dashboards, and SCADA-to-cloud bridges for independent producers across South Louisiana, East Texas, and the Permian. We replace the spreadsheet-and-fax workflow most small operators still live in.

Typical deliverables: field-ticket mobile app, AFE tracking, regulatory filings dashboard (LDNR/RRC), production aggregation from Allen-Bradley & Modbus PLCs.

Stack: Next.js · Node 20 · Postgres 15 · AWS IoT Core · Timescale · Twilio SMS
Case study — 14-rig independent, Lafayette LA
Replaced 38 spreadsheets with a single ticket portal. Cut month-end close from 11 days to 3, recovered ~$240K/yr in missed billable hours.
Practice 02

Medical Billing & Practice Ops

HIPAA-aligned claim scrubbing, patient statement automation, and front-desk tooling for independent physician groups. We are a Business Associate under HIPAA and carry a current SOC 2 Type II report.

Typical deliverables: 837P/837I claim builder, real-time eligibility (X12 270/271), patient text-statement workflow, Stripe-rails payment portal, denial-pattern dashboards.

Stack: Next.js · Node 20 · Postgres 15 · AWS PrivateLink to clearinghouse · KMS-wrapped PHI
Case study — 6-provider OB/GYN, Baton Rouge LA
Cut first-pass denial rate from 17% to 4.2%. Patient pay-on-time rate up 31% after switching to SMS statements.
Practice 03

Real Estate & Brokerage

MLS sync, commission splits, transaction coordinator workflows, and broker dashboards for regional brokerages in Louisiana, Mississippi, and East Texas. We handle the RESO Web API plumbing so brokers can stop paying per-seat for outdated portals.

Typical deliverables: agent CRM, transaction milestones, commission disbursement (1099 ready), branded buyer/seller portals.

Stack: Next.js · Node 20 · Postgres 15 · RESO Web API · Mapbox · DocuSign
Case study — 90-agent boutique, New Orleans LA
Replaced three legacy SaaS tools (CRM, transactions, commissions) with one integrated platform. Saved $84K/yr in subscriptions; reduced agent onboarding from 2 weeks to 2 days.
Practice 04

Custom SaaS & Integrations

If your business runs on a workflow nobody sells off the shelf, we'll build it. Typical engagements: 8–14 weeks, fixed scope, deployed to your AWS account or ours. We don't do staff augmentation and we don't do hourly billing.

Recent work: commercial fishing fleet quota tracker, parish-level property tax appeals portal, regional credit union deposit-routing dashboard.

Stack: whatever the problem demands — we are mostly Next.js / Node / Postgres / AWS, but pick the right tool every time.
